floor_history.headline: Recon: distance-2 = one sunk a1->v1 param copy; root cause proven (sched.c birthing LAUNCH boost on single-set live pseudo); multi-set defeats it but both value-reuse spellings cascade RA — frontier s

frontier.hypothesis: A second live set of arg1 whose lifetime stays inside the entry->sh(0x1A) window defeats the boost without creating segment 2, keeping RA on $v1
frontier.mechanism: reg_n_sets>=2 kills birthing boost (proven); a3-allocation came from the second segment overlapping post-call temps
frontier.next_probe: stage one of the pre-call s16 constant stores through arg1 (e.g. arg1 = constant; sp10[k] = arg1) and measure; sweep placements

frontier.hypothesis: Permuter finds a natural respelling of the clamp/init region with the copy at slot 3 and no post-call rotation
frontier.mechanism: small statement/type mutation space around the distance-2 baseline; boost-defeating forms are reachable by PERM var/statement moves
frontier.next_probe: permuter campaign seeded from baseline with clean single-function target.o, fresh-seed stopping rule, harvest before turn end

frontier.hypothesis: sched2 can be induced to lift the copy the remaining two slots (boost is off after reload)
frontier.mechanism: sched2 already moved it up one slot; block-0 dependence reshaping could push lui/addiu earlier and let the copy trail at slot 3
frontier.next_probe: cc1 -dR/-dS post-reload dump of block 0; enumerate C shapes giving the lui chain an earlier consumer
